name: Vercel AI
tagline: Vercel is a cloud platform for frontend development with first-class AI capabilities including the Vercel AI SDK (open-source TypeScript toolkit for building AI-powered UIs), instant serverless deployment, and edge AI inference. It powers Next.js applications with AI features at the edge, used by over 1 million developers.
